args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring (and the
FIN-212 requirement) specifying banker's rounding. This caused the
nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py (e.g. 2.665 rounded
to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build of payments-service failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but `src/money.py` was implemented with `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money`, matching the existing docstring and FIN-212.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on branch `fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding` (commit `08d3cd5986`) passed.

## Notes
This fix needs to ship in today's release, so merging promptly is appreciated.
